Components / Surfaces

Card row

.dr-card__row · components/card.css · kit specimen

Anatomy

Package delivery Today, 10:07 Earned₴180 View details
  1. 1.dr-card__rowThe band that leads the card: display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12. Structure only; no colour, size or radius.
  2. 2.dr-listing__bodyThe text, flex: 1, so it takes the space and the gap stays a real 12.
  3. 3.dr-numberThe figure, 20/700 tabular, beside the text and given no width. Its meaning (Earned) is in .sr-only.
  4. 4.dr-card__actionsThe action on its own row under the band, at full width; see Card action slot.

Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: Card row band.

States

No state of its own: the band is structure only, and nothing in it takes focus. The action under it takes the button states.

When to use

The card row is the third member of the .dr-card__* family, beside __actions and __link. It exists because .dr-card--row turns the whole card into a row, while wallet's earnings card is a column whose first child is one. .dr-listing__foot declares the same gap, but its name says foot and it cannot serve a band that leads.

The figure alone does not say whether money came in or went out, so .sr-only puts Earned in front of it for a screen reader (WCAG 1.3.1); sighted readers get it from the Recent label above the list. The action stays out of the band, so the button keeps its full 44pt target across the card instead of being squeezed in beside a price. Money that lands is paid or earned; money out is Withdraw.

Sources: DESIGN.md § Cards (.dr-card__row) · inventory.md § 1.3 (Card row band) · ui/kit.html Card row

Rule and anti-rule

Do

Package delivery Today, 10:07 Earned₴180 View details

A column card that opens with a name-and-figure line and closes with its action on a row of its own.

Don’t

Package delivery Today, 10:07 Earned₴180 View details

The action squeezed into the band beside the price: the text column narrows and the target shrinks. Put the button in .dr-card__actions under the band. When the whole card is one row with a picture, use the row card (.dr-card--row) instead.
